title: Tattoos & Antiques in Lawnton
body: A tattoo shop in Lawnton with over 30 years' combined experience, and a shop full of hand-picked antiques that are funky, grungy and different. All under one roof on Gympie Road, North Brisbane.
Every tattoo is drawn for you, from a first small script to a full sleeve. Every shelf holds something you won't find twice.

title: Custom tattoos on Brisbane's northside
body:
666 Tattoo is a working tattoo studio in Lawnton, run by artists with more than 30 years of combined experience in the Queensland tattoo industry. Every piece is drawn for you, whether it's your first small script or a full sleeve.

Our artists cover a wide range of styles: bold traditional and Japanese work, realism and portraits, blackwork, stipple and fine line, and neo traditional florals. Cover-ups are a speciality. If you've got an old tattoo you've fallen out of love with, Jimmy has spent more than 20 years reworking and covering pieces just like it.

We're a short drive from Strathpine, Petrie, Kallangur and North Lakes, so it's easy to pop in, talk through your idea and see the artists' portfolios in person. We also stock tattoo gift vouchers and quality aftercare products, so you can look after your new ink from day one.

title: An antiques shop with character
body:
Alongside the studio is our antiques shop: a curated collection of hand-picked pieces that are funky, grungy and different. It's the kind of place you come back to, because the shelves are always changing.

You'll find pre-war and 1930s Noritake porcelain, mid-century pressed glass, fine art ceramics, kitchenalia, vintage toys and collectables, dolls and the odd musical instrument. Most pieces are one of a kind, so when something's gone, it's gone.

Browse the current stock online, or come in and have a dig through the shelves at our Lawnton shop on Gympie Road. It's an easy trip from anywhere on Brisbane's northside and the Moreton Bay region.

title: Meet our tattoo artists
body: Each of our tattoo artists specialises in different areas of tattoo, and all of them work out of our Lawnton shop in Brisbane, Queensland.

title: Visit our Lawnton studio
body: Find us at 21/666 Gympie Road, Lawnton. We're a short drive from Strathpine, Petrie, Bray Park, Kallangur, Brendale and North Lakes, and easy to reach from anywhere in the Moreton Bay region. Drop in to talk through a tattoo idea or browse the antiques.

title: What we're about
body:
We are a unique shop for unique folks.

We offer different specialty types of tattoos with a combined expertise of over 30 years, alongside a curated collection of hand-picked antiques that are funky, grungy and different. With both of these passions, we could only top it off with a relaxed atmosphere where you're welcome to hang around, have a chat and take your time.

title: Tattoos, aftercare and gift vouchers
body:
Our team are well versed in the Australian, and more specifically Queensland, tattoo industry with plenty of experience and knowledge to ensure your next tattoo is the best it can be.

We remain committed to the best experience; meaning we have a tonne of other services and products you can check out while you're in the shop. We stock gift vouchers, merchandise, the best aftercare tattoo products possible and we strive to exceed your expectations.
